nodes.label: XState adoption path
nodes.author: Project Owner + Engine
nodes.rationale: XState adoption path is engine-first and shadow/adapter-first; no big-bang authority switch.

nodes.label: Deterministic Replay
nodes.author: Project Owner + Engine
nodes.rationale: Deterministic replay/hash compatibility is the primary migration constraint; design now as XState-forward without binding replay validity to framework internals.

nodes.label: Policy-Based Verification
nodes.author: Project Owner + Engine
nodes.rationale: Verification is policy-based with standard and official profiles; policy is immutable per match once play begins.

nodes.label: DEC-2C-002 - Machine binding in signatures is optional
nodes.author: Project Owner + Engine
nodes.norm_label: dec-2c-002 - machine binding in signatures is optional

nodes.label: Machine Binding in Signatures
nodes.author: Project Owner + Engine
nodes.rationale: Machine binding in signatures is optional by policy: required for official, optional for standard/casual contexts.

nodes.label: Offline Verifiable Official Outputs
nodes.author: Project Owner + Platform
nodes.rationale: official outputs must be verifiable offline by third parties; public-key distribution direction is JWKS-compatible metadata.

nodes.label: Official Spectator Delay Policy
nodes.author: Project Owner
nodes.rationale: Official spectator delay policy minimum floor is 2 turns with default 3 turns; event-configurable override allowed.

nodes.label: Hidden-State Reveal Default
nodes.author: Project Owner
nodes.rationale: Hidden-state reveal default is endOfMatch; endOfRound is a supported option; reveal delay may be configured.

nodes.label: Event Topology
nodes.author: Project Owner + Platform
nodes.rationale: Event topology uses one private canonical ingress stream plus trusted derived streams split by audience; direct public read from ingress is disallowed.

nodes.label: Derived-Feature Stream
nodes.author: Project Owner + Platform
nodes.rationale: Production analytics starts from a public-safe derived-feature stream (redacted hidden state by default).

nodes.label: Post-State Payloads
nodes.author: Project Owner + Platform
nodes.rationale: Public stream defaults to public-safe post-state payloads; hash+reference-only variants are future extensions.

nodes.label: Guest Aliases
nodes.author: Project Owner + Platform
nodes.rationale: Ranked-like mode may run with guest aliases but remains explicitly non-authoritative until auth/persistence exists.

nodes.label: Stable Cross-Match Pseudonyms
nodes.author: Project Owner + Platform
nodes.rationale: Stable cross-match pseudonyms are treated as an auth-provider concern and stay decoupled from game rules/engine semantics.

nodes.label: Duel-First Scope
nodes.author: Project Owner
nodes.rationale: Scope is Duel first; multi-format policy generalization is deferred to a later unit.

nodes.label: Authoritative View Model Projection
nodes.author: Project Owner + Platform
nodes.rationale: The engine defines one observer-relative projection tailored to the requester's role. Raw GameState is internal and MUST NOT be broadcast to live clients. The View Model is the sole authoritative source for visual state and allowed interactions.
